bias.en: Range breaking down · lost $128.6, SAR at $126.7
bias.zh: 区间下破 · 跌破 $128.6，SAR 位于 $126.7

read.en: SPCX fell 7.7% on Nov 20 to $127.79, its lowest close since Nov 5, trading $127.25–133.84. It is below the 5-day ($137.8, falling), 10-day ($139.3, rising), 30-day ($143.3) and 100-day ($141.4), both falling (no 200-day yet). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 20, below zero; Parabolic SAR is still bullish since Nov 11, now at $126.69 just under the price, and RSI is 38.5.
read.zh: SPCX 11月20日下跌 7.7%，收于 $127.79，为 11月5日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $127.25–133.84。股价位于 5 日（$137.8，下行）、10 日（$139.3，上行）、30 日（$143.3）和 100 日均线（$141.4）下方，后两者均在下行（尚无 200 日均线）。MACD 于 11月20日下穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起仍看多，现位于 $126.69，紧贴股价下方，RSI 为 38.5。

read.en: The drop broke the $135.2 (Nov 9, 16 and 19 lows) and $128.6 (Nov 6 low) supports, now resistance. Resistance is $128.6–130.4, then $133.8–135.5 (Nov 20 high, Nov 16 low) and $137.8–139.3 (5- and 10-day). Support is $125.8–127.3 (SAR, Nov 20 low), then $120.4–123.6 (Nov 5 low and close) and $104.8–107. A close above $130.4 would target $133.8–135.5; below $125.8, flipping the SAR, $120.4–123.6.
